channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD OpenSSH
item.description: Threat Signal 81. OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

item.title: CVE-2024-36401 — OSGeo GeoServer
item.description: Threat Signal 80. OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools contains an improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code vulnerability due to unsafely evaluating property names as XPath expressions. This allows unauthenticated attackers to conduct remote code execution via specially crafted input.

item.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Project MONAI MONAI Label
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-7841 — Schneider Electric U.motion Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in U.motion Builder software which could cause unwanted code execution when an improper set of characters is entered.

item.title: CVE-2026-134624 — N-able MailAssure
item.description: Threat Signal 69. N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

item.title: CVE-2026-109619 — PHP Group PHP
item.description: Threat Signal 66. PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad GmbH Zammad
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

item.title: CVE-2026-85102 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

item.title: CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

item.title: CVE-2026-85706 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 66. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

item.title: CVE-2026-20079 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-83548 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-72898 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

item.title: CVE-2026-50522 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-21643 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2025-40551 — SolarWinds Web Help Desk
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution, which would allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine. This could be exploited without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2025-59287 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-20281 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2014-3931 — Looking Glass Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2023-33538 — TP-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 66. TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-29824 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2025-24472 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted CSF proxy requests.

item.title: CVE-2024-13160 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2025-22225 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 66. VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2024-26169 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-1086 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Linux kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the netfilter: nf_tables component that allows an attacker to achieve local privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2024-30051 — Microsoft DWM Core Library
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft DWM Core Library contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-27532 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

item.title: CVE-2023-23376 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-41073 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

item.title: CVE-2018-19322 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-3493 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2013-6282 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-37969 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2018-4990 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Acrobat and Reader have a double free vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-5030 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2008-0655 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an unespecified vulnerability described as a design flaw which could allow a specially crafted file to be printed silently an arbitrary number of times.

item.title: CVE-2015-1671 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when components of Windows, .NET Framework, Office, Lync, and Silverlight fail to properly handle TrueType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2018-19943 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2019-11707 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability that can occur when manipulating JavaScript objects due to issues in Array.pop, allowing for an exploitable crash.

item.title: CVE-2019-1130 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) improperly handles hard links.

item.title: CVE-2022-24521 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-27852 — Checkbox Checkbox Survey
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in CheckboxWeb.dll of Checkbox Survey allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2014-0130 — Rails Ruby on Rails
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Directory traversal vulnerability in actionpack/lib/abstract_controller/base.rb in the implicit-render implementation in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2019-1129 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2015-2424 — Microsoft PowerPoint
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft PowerPoint allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted Office document.

item.title: CVE-2014-0496 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for code execution.
